integrity: The infinite-index theorem has an analytic proof. A standalone standard-library exact-rational verifier supports the explicit example; finite tests do not certify infinite quantifiers. Earlier priority remains subject to independent bibliographic assessment.
scientific_limitations: The condition that the product of the Poisson rates is at most one is sufficient rather than claimed optimal. The full parameter-wise curvature sign pattern, maximal finite violation run, and scaling thresholds are not classified. The original signed Skellam law, the classical Turán inequality, and the discrete-order-statistic preservation theorem are previously known. At high intensities the guaranteed violation windows may fall in small-probability regions rather than the central mass.
title: Folding a Skellam law: protected log-concavity and arbitrarily long curvature reversals
